title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations: Customer Authorization of a Four-Wheel Alignment Correction
content:
## Authorization rule

On an ADAS Sensor Calibrations customer-pay order an out-of-spec alignment is corrected only once the customer authorizes the correction by paying the authorization amount, and the correction's charge, posted on the day the correction is made, is the correction quote the customer authorized. Whatever the order still owes after the authorization amount is paid on completion by one of the tier's accepted payment methods.

The amount collected when a customer authorizes an alignment correction is not fixed until the order carries the alignment check charge owed for the checks recorded on it.

Stated the other way round: while the order does not yet carry the alignment check charge owed for the checks recorded on it, the amount collected at authorization is not yet a fixed figure.

## Points of the rule

| Question | Answer from the rule |
|---|---|
| Is an out-of-spec alignment on a customer-pay order corrected before the customer pays anything? | No. It is corrected only once the customer authorizes the correction by paying the authorization amount. |
| What is the correction charged at? | The correction quote the customer authorized, posted on the day the correction is made. |
| What happens to the rest of what the order owes? | It is paid on completion by one of the tier's accepted payment methods. |

## The customer's authorization payment: `pay_alignment_correction_authorization_61ce2890`

**Capability.** With `pay_alignment_correction_authorization_61ce2890` the customer authorizes the four-wheel alignment correction on their own sensor calibration order by paying the authorization amount. One call books a single customer payment, dated today, on the calibration order named, for the amount given and by the method given. What is owed on the order falls by exactly that amount, and the payment appears in the order's calibration money history as a customer payment.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_alignment_correction_authorization_61ce2890` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `adas_order_id` | Reference number of the customer's calibration order, as read to the customer by the desk from the calibration order lookup | Id |
| `amount_usd` | The authorization amount in US dollars | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; charged and stored exactly as given |
| `payment_method` | How the customer pays | One of: `card` — the customer pays with a debit or credit card, including over the phone; `cash` — the customer hands over cash at the center; `check` — the customer pays with a personal check at the center; `remittance` — only for an insurer glass program paying under its own remittance, never for a customer paying for themselves |

**Return.** A successful call returns a receipt carrying the payment's reference number, which the customer can quote afterwards:
- `status` — the text "paid" when the payment was booked;
- `adas_entry_id` — reference number of the payment;
- `adas_order_id` — the calibration order paid;
- `payer_kind` — always "customer";
- `payment_method` — the method used;
- `amount_usd` — the amount paid, USD, 2 decimal places;
- `entry_date` — the business date of the payment, YYYY-MM-DD.
